concept.reason: 2024 real fossil photographs, measured cranial table and reconstruction suffice; no generated concept art.

extra_views.reason: FORM-GATE-01: original inventory requires evidence-backed Dromornis form comparison. Equal-size lateral rostral profiles use the exact unchanged GLB and a documented primary fossil photograph; not an extra model render or concept image.

classification: Dromornithidae, Galloanserae; exact placement debated, not a living goose species
scope: Complete robust flightless bird with tall goose-shaped bill and low cranial-rostral casque. Subsequent pool not frozen72.

scale.height_status: Approximate upright reconstruction informed by Flinders VAMP over2m summary; NOT exact articulated specimen measurement. Neck posture variable.
scale.measurement_note: 2024 Appendix2 TableA1. P59516 total296mm is minimum because displaced rostrum overlaps cranium. P59521 is separate specimen. Do NOT merge into false single exact specimen.

diagnostic_targets: Broad robust feathered body, heavy walking legs and thick neck; no gracile ostrich body.
Tall but comparatively broad rounded goose-like upper bill, not a raptor hook or huge deep Dromornis block.
Low broad triangular casque across dorsal bill base, not a tall cassowary horn or Sylviornis exaggerated knob.
Two small reduced folded wings present, unlike completely wingless moa.
Three forward digits with blunt hoof-like claws, no recurved raptorial talons, no swimming webbing implied from goose nickname.
Conservative muted feather/skin palette, bare head-neck coverage and colors treated as inferred.
uncertainties: 2024 cranial reconstruction combines fossils with deformation corrections; do not copy fossil crushing or cracked edges into live anatomy.
Soft contour, skin coverage, plumage and colors not preserved, author art is interpretation.
Overall2m body height is an estimate; original limb specimen dimensions not measured here.
Exact relationship within Galloanserae unresolved; giant-goose popular shorthand not taxonomic identification as Anatidae.
acceptance: Whole original robust bird and updated2024 bill/casque retained.
Tiny wings remain, three hoof-like toes, not moa winglessness or raptor feet.
Measured skull boundaries explicit, four exactGLBviews and two reproducible builds then independentQA.
